name: recordings-broker-marker
description: A collected forced gap and a ctrl_l answer: the recording shows the gap marker (sidecar code 2), the broker marker (code 5) for the ctrl_l choice, and the code-1 input frame carrying 0x0C after it, and the audit log holds the session.stale_choice event for it. The marker precedes the input frame because the core records an input frame before it sends it (Contract §13); who chose is on the audit event only. A collected run must show each of the three, or its broker-originated send is unproven. Every broker marker found in a recording must have a session.stale_choice audit event for its choice, and a ctrl_l marker must be followed by its 0x0C input frame.
